products.description:
SwissBake® Vanilla Crème Cake Base Mix is a premium, Swiss-formulated solution for preparing rich, dense and moist, textured cake bases, muffins and pound cakes.

SwissBake® Vanilla Crème Cake Mix is an ideal choice for any professional baker looking to bake a range of dense cake bases and muffins.

products.name: Gluten Free Cake Mix
products.description:
SwissBake® Gluten Free Cake Mix is a go-to solution for baking exceptional gluten-free cakes and pastries.

Our gluten-free flour for cakes is made from natural ingredients and is designed for ease of use with straightforward baking recipes.

Natural Ingredients: Formulated with natural ingredients for superior taste.
Dedicated Facility: Handled exclusively in our gluten-free facility for guaranteed integrity.

SwissBake® Gluten Free Cake Mix is perfect for professional bakers aiming to offer gluten-free delights that meet the highest standards of taste and texture. Elevate your baking with our expertly crafted gluten free cake mix today.

products.name: Ghee Crème Cake Mix
products.description: SwissBake® Ghee Crème Cake Mix brings together Swiss formulation expertise and the traditional richness of ghee—a traditional ingredient deeply rooted in Middle Eastern and South Asian culinary heritage.

products.name: Crème Cake Mix (Cocoa)
products.description:
SwissBake® Crème Cake Mix (Cocoa) is a special mix developed by Swiss experts to produce cakes with a dense, moist and creamy texture.

The complete mix includes all the necessary ingredients in precise measurements, making it easy to use with only the addition of fresh eggs, oil and water.

Infused with essential orange oil & natural colour.
Versatile application for muffins, tea cakes & pound cakes.
Imparts a refreshing flavour & dense crumb.

products.name: Butter Crème Cake Mix
products.description: SwissBake® Butter Crème Cake Mix is a high-performance base mix developed for professional bakers seeking consistent quality, rich buttery flavour, and superior crumb matrix.

products.name: Banana Cake Mix
products.description:
SwissBake® Banana Cake Mix is a convenient mix to prepare egg-based banana flavoured sponges and cakes with a delicious taste and mouthfeel.

Formulated with real banana flour, SwissBake® Banana Cake Mix is ideal for a variety of food service businesses.

Key Features
Made using real banana flour
Delicious and moist banana cake
Consistent volume and texture

products.name: Egg-Free Donut Concentrate 25
products.description:
SwissBake® Egg-Free Donut Concentrate 25 is a specialized, high-performance concentrate formulated to produce soft, light, and evenly aerated yeast-raised donuts.

It supports efficient handling, dependable proofing, and standardized finish across a wide range of donut formats.
